note: sha256_pre_seed hashes the config as first frozen, with literal placeholders <TRAINING_SEED_A3>/<TRAINING_SEED_B3> and an unreserved eval block. sha256_post_seed hashes it after experiments/seed_registry.py reserved 4V4_ENTITY_REPAIR_TRAINING (17700001-17700002) and 4V4_ENTITY_REPAIR_CROSSOVER_EVAL (17800001-17800192) and the document was amended in place with those concrete values (see amended_utc in the parent doc). Both hashes are kept, in a separate sidecar file to avoid a self-referential hash, so the parent doc's launch commands can now be verified byte-for-byte against sha256_post_seed before either training job is started.
